Q223_0_rho_first.note: Spearman (midranks) between the motor-readout R and the descending-readout R across the cohort. Read BEFORE the carrier's contrast because it decides whether the contrast carries any information at all.

Q223_1_primary.note: C_log(g) = log R_motor(g) - log R_desc(g). COHORT-FREE by construction: a cell's value cannot move when the comparison set moves (L222's cohort-relocation law applied prophylactically)

Q223_2_homolog_and_common.note: L222's companion set: the OWN-cohort reading, the COMMON-cohort (union) reading and the COHORT-FREE raw values, all three reported so a cohort relocation cannot flip the sign unseen.

Q223_3_companion_rank.note: C_rank = (midrank_motor - midrank_desc)/n on the common pool cohort + {actor}; reported beside C_log because L218 measured the same cell landing on OPPOSITE sides of the same null under two currencies of one quantity.

Q223_4_descriptive.note: ratio_of_medians_log is the OBSERVED-DERIVABLE quantity (PREREG 0e) and is reported beside the median of ratios precisely because they are not the same number.

Q223_3.registered: carrier C_log pct < mirror C_log pct

Q223_6.registered: mirror C_log pct > 0.10 (the twin is NOT specific)

observed_derivable_DESCRIPTION.note: PREREG 0e / Kriegeskorte 2009: l212/static.json was read while scoping, so the actors' R values in BOTH legs, hence both C_log values and their difference, and both cohort MEDIANS (hence the ratio-of-medians) were derivable before measurement and carry NO branch. Every branch sits on the cohort's per-cell JOINT distribution, its rho, and the percentiles of a contrast - none of which are determined by the stored summary.

limitations: v783's cohort mass match is LOOSE (log-spread 0.316 / 0.349 against the 0.15 bar L212 registered and FAILED, Q212-5) - every percentile here inherits that looseness; stated, not repaired.

v783 is BRAIN-ONLY. L222 measured that ALL in-brain out-edges of BOTH actors sit below synapse 4, so the descending readout is a within-volume stand-in for 'everything else this cell talks to', not the cell's real output targets.
COH_C is 100 cells, so one cell is one percentile point (L207's resolution law): a 0.10 bar cannot separate 0.10 from 0.11.
ANATOMICAL leg only: no row mask, no settle, no seed, no rollouts - wiring geometry, NOT an operating point (L164). Operator powers are walks WITH revisits, not paths.

The contrast cancels readout SIZE only to the extent that size enters every cell's two legs the same way; it does not cancel a readout-specific DEGREE structure. L233 is the card that asks that question directly.
